name: Alok Industries Limited
summary: Alok Industries Limited manufactures and sells textile products in India and internationally. The company provides polyester yarns, including recycled drawn textured yarns (DTY), biodegradable DTY, specialty DTY, fully dyed yarn, polyester staple fiber, polyester chips, and partially oriented yarns; ring spun, gassed, two-for-one, and open-end yarns; apparel fabrics, such as piece dyed, yarn dyed, printed fabrics, and specialty fiber blends; and bed and bath home textiles comprising sheet sets, duvet sets, and quilts.
